initial.title: [Backlog][C-SDLC v2] Retire duplicate csdlc-init entrypoint
initial.goal: Make csdlc-issue create the only active issue-creation command and delete the duplicate csdlc-init surface.
initial.required_outcome: The duplicate binary, declarations, installed-set requirements, proof fixtures, and active operator guidance are removed while claim-free create/validate/doctor/bind behavior remains proven.
authority_boundary: csdlc-issue create is sole creation authority
PR body must use Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5883
This is split issue/code publication authority, not repository cutover or issue migration
operator_constraints: Execute after #5895 and rebase before editing shared installer surfaces
initial.task_boundary: Delete only the duplicate creation entrypoint and active references while preserving creation and binding semantics.
deliverables: Deleted csdlc-init binary declaration and source
Updated current operator skills and docs
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Active operator guidance and callers use csdlc-issue create
AC-2: csdlc-init is absent from Cargo, declared and installed inventories, and focused proof fixtures
AC-3: Current non-historical documentation contains no csdlc-init creation instruction
AC-5: Real-binary create behavior preserves validation, idempotence, rollback, and conflict rejection
AC-6: Installed create/validate/doctor/bind workflow passes without claims or compatibility routing
dependencies: #5895 must settle first because installer/coexistence proof overlaps
initial.plan_summary: Rebase after #5895, classify active versus historical references, delete the duplicate command and active requirements, update current guidance, and prove real installed claim-free creation and binding.

steps.action: Rebase after #5895 and classify every csdlc-init occurrence as active or historical.
Delete the duplicate Cargo binary and remove it from current installer, coexistence, proof, and skill authority.
Update current non-historical docs and operator adapters to csdlc-issue create without compatibility wording.
Run focused real-binary creation parity, installed inventory, and create/validate/doctor/bind proof.

invariants: Identical typed request and record semantics
risks: Missing a generated or installed-skill reference
Accidentally weakening create rollback or idempotence tests
stop_conditions: #5895 has not settled or shared files cannot be cleanly rebased
Any proposed compatibility alias or wrapper

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove real csdlc-issue create validation, atomicity, idempotence, and conflict behavior.
Prove csdlc-init is absent from declared and installed sets and its reappearance fails.
Prove active skill and documentation routes name only csdlc-issue create.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on any active csdlc-init authority, installed binary presence, creation behavior regression, historical evidence mutation, or compatibility routing.
review_prompts: Is every removed reference active rather than historical evidence?
Does the installed set lack csdlc-init and reject its return?
Does csdlc-issue create retain atomicity, idempotence, and fail-closed validation?
initial.review_scope: Duplicate entrypoint deletion, active operator routing, installed inventory, and creation behavior parity only.
